name: lSCurrencyFormat
description: Formats a number in a locale-specific currency format.
syntax: lSCurrencyFormat( object number, [string type], [locale locale], [boolean useBrackets] )

params.name: type
params.description:
* local: the currency format and currency symbol used in the locale.
* international: the international standard currency format and currency symbol of the locale.
* none: the currency format used in the locale without a currency symbol.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale to use instead of the locale of the page when processing the function

params.name: useBrackets
params.description: When a number is negative, by default, it is wrapped in brackets
